name: bbm-mods

plugins.name: ci-preflight
plugins.description: Runs the fast CI checks (schema-drift, portal selftests, migration lints, workflow pins) before a git push leaves the session; refuses update-branch while checks fail or run; warns on repeat pushes within 10 minutes.

plugins.name: fleet-tracker
plugins.description: Live dashboard of cloud sessions an orchestrator spins up, with wake-ups on blocked/failed/review/done.

plugins.name: draft-session
plugins.description: v2_s6 Draft session guard: contract injected from the refresh-agent file, draft-lint on /draft-done, Draft receipt blocked until lint passes; cloud sessions pin with draft_pin and get the credentialed CI lint.

plugins.name: run-state
plugins.description: Band with the refresh run's stage, next READY section, Pass A age and missing receipts, plus a guard that refuses receipt writes for sections the conductor has not marked READY (asks when the plan is unreadable).

plugins.name: session-close
plugins.description: Lists the close-out obligations a session left unmet (INGEST, Jira comment, run state, scheduled checkpoints, Pass verdicts) on /close-out or a wrap-up turn.

plugins.name: refresh-run-guard
plugins.description: Guards the refresh run: denies hand-written receipts and Bash publish paths, tracks Pass A freshness, checks Webflow item payloads.

plugins.name: jira-closer
plugins.description: When a session merges a PR or arms auto-merge, makes it update the PR's Jira ticket (Done, or a state comment); blocks the turn's end once while a ticket is untouched.

plugins.name: pillar-brief-guard
plugins.description: Enforces the pillar-brief rules in any session: article ideas name a parent article, product selection and new article files need an approved (<= 365 days) brief, approvals name an approver.

plugins.name: prod-deploy-guard
plugins.description: Refuses production deploys and DDL from a session (MCP deploy_edge_function, wrangler/supabase CLI deploys, DDL via execute_sql); apply_migration asks. GitHub is production (LC-421).

plugins.name: bulk-write-guard
plugins.description: Refuses Supabase execute_sql writes that do not prove, in their own text, that they touch 5 rows or fewer; larger writes go through a data-changes/ package (LC-1683).

plugins.name: spend-delete-ask
plugins.description: Asks the operator before any tool that moves money, spends a balance or deletes something a session cannot restore (Stripe, PayPal, QuickBooks, link carts, Roominate, Airtable/Notion/Drive/GitHub/Cloudflare/Supabase deletes).

plugins.name: no-browser-as-me
plugins.description: Refuses driving the operator's own browser or desktop: the chrome-browser / computer-use skills and any Chrome or computer-use MCP server.

plugins.name: recurring-successor-guard
plugins.description: Refuses closing a recurring Jira ticket (label `recurring` or a 'next due' line) until the session created its successor ticket or scheduled task.

plugins.name: reply-footer-check
plugins.description: Blocks a turn's end once when the reply's last line is not `Noted separately: <keys>` / `Nothing`, or names a ticket no Jira call touched.

plugins.name: knowledge-superseded-check
plugins.description: After a read of knowledge_memories / knowledge_articles, names superseded rows and their replacements, and nudges a query that skips is_active / superseded_by.

plugins.name: session-title-nudge
plugins.description: Puts the session-naming convention (`<TICKET> — <summary>`) in front of the model at session start, and a rename reminder when createJiraIssue mints a key.

plugins.name: skill-copy-guard
plugins.description: Refuses edits to .claude/skills/ byte copies; skills change in brand-bridge-media/claude-skills, and the mirror brings them here.

plugins.name: dispatch-watch
plugins.description: After a session dispatches a workflow through the github-dispatch bridge, checks the run every minute and wakes the session when it finishes, fails to start, or runs long; flags a finish under 2 minutes as the did-nothing shape.

plugins.name: pr-ci-watch
plugins.description: After a git push or create_pull_request, checks the branch's PR every 2 minutes and wakes the session once its CI has finished, so a session never depends on GitHub's PR events alone.

plugins.name: supabase-guard
plugins.description: Supabase exposure rules before SQL runs or a migration is written (execute_sql, apply_migration, migration-file Write/Edit): blocks a table without RLS, a view without security_invoker, an unrevoked or search_path-less SECURITY DEFINER, and an unmarked GRANT to anon/authenticated; warns on a function without search_path. Same rules as the lint-supabase-rules PR gate.

plugins.name: image-weight-guard
plugins.description: Blocks Webflow CMS item writes and asset uploads that load an image over 400 KB or not WebP/AVIF/SVG (HEAD check before the image is loaded); asks when size or type cannot be determined. Fix: route through generated-image-intake (LC-1883).

plugins.name: mod-freshness
plugins.description: Warns a long-lived session, once per mod, when a mod it loaded at start has since changed in the bbm-mods mirror, so the operator knows to start a fresh session.

plugins.name: where-we-stand
plugins.description: When a session starts diagnosing a recurring problem or is about to state a ticket's or article's status, looks the topic up read-only (knowledge, Jira newest comment, GitHub, production) and injects one card: know / state / verified | not verified | conflict. Once per topic, three per session.

description: Claude Code mods (plugins of function hooks) for Brand Bridge Media sessions; sources live in claude-mods/.
